+        escaped_name = distribution_name(self._package.name)
 
-        wheels = list(
-            dist.glob(f"{distribution_name(self._package.name)}-{version}-*.whl")
-        )

-            dist.glob(f"{distribution_name(self._package.name)}-{version}.tar.gz")
